_doc: OECD Short-term economic statistics revisions database (DSD_STES_REVISIONS@DF_STES_REVISIONS; successor of the MEI Original Release Data and Revisions Database). Each EDITION holds the data as published in that month's Main Economic Indicators edition. CLI (LI_AA) of an edition is eligible from 'cli_public_by', the date of the earliest dated public report of that edition's CLI figures (an upper bound on the release date); where none is verified the edition month end applies. CPI (CP) of an edition is eligible only after its edition month has ended (conservative; no MEI print date is claimed). Each evidence item carries its own publication 'date'; a page lists only items published on or before its last eligible day. From the January 2023 edition the OECD no longer issues CLI news releases (its release of 8 Dec 2022 was the final one in that format) and the database carries the CLI only for the 13 economies it still estimates. These editions are admitted from the date, in Europe/Warsaw time, of the earliest DBnomics git commit of the OECD MEI_CLI dataset that carries the same CLIs (basis 'dated DBnomics git commit carrying this edition's figures'): 'dbnomics_check' names the commit, and the builder and the audit re-check that, for all 13 economies, the commit's latest reference month equals the edition's and every overlapping value agrees within rounding (the database prints two decimals, DBnomics five; largest difference 0.005).
